question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable Gateway approval protocol and shared-state lifecycle as the stable foundation for cross-surface clients?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but it defines long-lived storage, authorization, and protocol semantics for several dependent clients, which requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Adopt the durable foundation
options.body: Land after exact-head required checks and explicit acceptance of retention, authorization, and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Narrow the stable contract
options.body: Keep internal persistence while deferring or reducing public generic methods and retained projections.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Decline the durable core direction and hold the dependent channel and mobile branches.

recommendation.title: Adopt the durable foundation
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head required checks and explicit acceptance of retention, authorization, and upgrade semantics.
